PricingTable.useWhen: The feature-by-plan grid on a pricing page: every feature as a row, a column per plan, under the plan cards.
PricingTable.avoidWhen: Comparing us with competitors (use ComparisonTable), or the plans themselves with prices and buttons (use PricingCards).

ComparisonTable.useWhen: Comparing our product with competitors or alternatives, feature by feature, with rows as content items.
ComparisonTable.avoidWhen: Comparing our own plans' features on a pricing page: use PricingTable.

alternatives.when: our plans' features on a pricing page
